title: DFT self-consistent field calculation for GaP
action: Run a DFT SCF calculation for the GaP primitive cell using Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x to obtain the Kohn-Sham eigenvalues and wavefunctions on a dense k-point grid, including the Γ point. Use the PBE functional and SSSP pseudopotentials.
description: Obtain ground-state charge density and band energies needed for subsequent phonon and electron-phonon calculations.

title: DFPT phonon calculation at Γ
action: Run ph.x to compute the dynamical matrix at the Γ point, obtaining phonon frequencies and eigenvectors for the optical modes (TO and LO).
description: Provides the TO(Γ) and LO(Γ) phonon frequencies and polarization vectors required for the Raman tensor evaluation.

title: EPW Wannier interpolation and electron-phonon coupling
action: Run epw.x to perform Wannier interpolation of the electronic bands and phonon dispersions, compute the electron-phonon matrix elements on a fine k/q mesh, and evaluate the Raman tensor components using the quasistatic approximation and experimental gap parameters E0=2.78 eV, Δ0=0.082 eV.
description: Generate the raw Raman tensor data as a function of incident photon energy.

title: Generate resonant Raman cross-section curves
action: From the Raman tensor data produced by EPW, construct the cross-section curves for first-order TO(Γ) and second-order Γ1 and Γ15 components (in arbitrary units) and write them to a CSV file with at least 20 points spanning the energy range.
description: CSV file with columns: photon_energy_relative_E0 (eV), cross_section_first_order, cross_section_second_order_Gamma1, cross_section_second_order_Gamma15. Values are in consistent but arbitrary units; the curves must capture the resonant peaks at E0 and E0+Δ0.
output_schema: Header: photon_energy_relative_E0, cross_section_first_order, cross_section_second_order_Gamma1, cross_section_second_order_Gamma15. Numeric columns; rows for ≥20 distinct photon energies between -0.4 and +0.3 eV.

title: Compute deformation potentials D1 and D15
action: Identify the two-LO(Γ) and TO+LO(Γ) peaks in the second-order spectra, compute their integrated intensities (area under the curve) relative to the first-order TO(Γ) peak, apply the paper’s equations to extract D1 and D15, and write the results to a JSON file.
description: JSON containing intensity ratios and the deformation potentials D1 and D15 in eV.
output_schema: Keys: intensity_ratio_two_LO (number), intensity_ratio_TO_plus_LO (number), delta2_omega0_over_delta1_omega0_Gamma1 (number), delta2_omega0_over_delta1_omega0_Gamma15 (number), D1_eV (number), D15_eV (number).
